name: Stone arch hide
label: Hides
lead: Hide shaped like a layered stone arch in brown, orange and greenish tones - shelter underneath and stepped layers for climbing.

description.html: This hide is shaped like a layered stone arch, with a series of stepped slabs descending toward one side. The colors are natural and blend into each other, from brown and orange to greenish tones, like rock covered with lichen.

Under the arch there is a roomy cavity with an entrance at the front, where your animal can hide and rest. On the outside, the stepped layers serve as a place to climb and look around, which active lizards that like to explore appreciate. So one piece of decor provides both shelter and extra surface to move on.
The multicolored tones let the arch fit into both desert and forest setups.

If you place it on the warm side, the top layers can be used for basking and the cavity below as a warm hide. Make sure the lamp is not too close to the top layer. Set the hide directly on the terrarium floor so your animal cannot dig underneath it, and add a second hide on the cool side. Wash it with warm water and a brush.
